description: Defines the PersistableBundle class, a C++ implementation for a key-value mapping that supports various data types and persistence, used within Android's binder IPC framework.

classes.name: PersistableBundle
classes.description: A class representing a mapping from String keys to various data types, supporting serialization and deserialization for IPC.
